runs.name: final-3000-ema
runs.notes: The best base on record run half again as long with its trajectory averaged. Two things point here. A thousand steps with the average already scores what two thousand without it did, which makes the average the largest single effect measured tonight; and at a thousand steps the average spans the whole run including its undertrained start, while at three thousand a decay of 0.999 spans only the last third, which is the tail average it is meant to be. The squared-error term is left out: against the control on an identical data order it was worth +0.51 dB of the pair on the final weights and +0.03 on the average, which is a wash that moves weight from the 100k budget to the 250k one rather than lifting either.
